item.content:encoded:
This may not change your vote (obviously), but I thought I should try to explain the structure of this article. It is based off the remarks of the "orange voice" (Rip Van Winkle) who is talking to another person (purple voice). Every section has some significance to a point that the "orange voice" wants to make.

They all separately highlight different perspectives of the Zamendenbora. As reiterated by the orange voice, some hate the land, some try to study, some even worship the land. Many people who live in Asisiter Mij and Zamendenbora believe that Rip Van Winkle (orange voice) is the key to the whole place, but thats meant to be a red herring(as revealed at the end) at that this infinite, mighty land is created by the thoughts and dreams of simple plants and animals. So it supposes the question at the end that the power of sentient people must be even more powerful and awesome.

The connecting point for everything is the orange voice. The km^2 is present only to exaggerate the "dream logic" of the entire place. Thank you for reading and giving me this critique!
